cards.back:
A mountain that can send out hot ash, gas and melted rock.
Bahasa Indonesia: gunung berapi
Example: Smoke rose from the top of the volcano early this morning.
cards.say: volcano. Smoke rose from the top of the volcano early this morning.

cards.back:
One of the seven very large areas of land on Earth.
Bahasa Indonesia: benua
Example: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
cards.say: continent. Asia is the largest continent in the world.

cards.back:
An imaginary line around the middle of the Earth.
Bahasa Indonesia: khatulistiwa
Example: Indonesia lies across the equator, so it is hot all year.
cards.say: equator. Indonesia lies across the equator, so it is hot all year.

cards.back:
A piece of land almost surrounded by water.
Bahasa Indonesia: semenanjung
Example: The Malay peninsula has the sea on three sides.
cards.say: peninsula. The Malay peninsula has the sea on three sides.

cards.back:
A small river that flows into a larger river.
Bahasa Indonesia: anak sungai
Example: The tributary joins the main river near the old bridge.
cards.say: tributary. The tributary joins the main river near the old bridge.

cards.back:
A sudden shaking of the ground.
Bahasa Indonesia: gempa bumi
Example: The earthquake made the windows rattle for a few seconds.
cards.say: earthquake. The earthquake made the windows rattle for a few seconds.

cards.back:
A huge, slow-moving river of ice.
Bahasa Indonesia: gletser
Example: The glacier slid down the mountain a few centimetres each day.
cards.say: glacier. The glacier slid down the mountain a few centimetres each day.

cards.back:
The gas in the air that people and animals need to breathe.
Bahasa Indonesia: oksigen
Example: Plants give out oxygen when they make their food.
cards.say: oxygen. Plants give out oxygen when they make their food.

cards.back:
The force that pulls things towards the Earth.
Bahasa Indonesia: gravitasi
Example: Gravity makes an apple drop to the ground.
cards.say: gravity. Gravity makes an apple drop to the ground.

cards.back:
To change from a liquid into a gas.
Bahasa Indonesia: menguap
Example: Puddles evaporate when the Sun shines on them.
cards.say: evaporate. Puddles evaporate when the Sun shines on them.

cards.back:
To change from a gas into a liquid.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengembun
Example: Steam condenses into drops on a cold window.
cards.say: condense. Steam condenses into drops on a cold window.

cards.back:
The curved path of one object around another in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: orbit
Example: The Earth completes one orbit around the Sun every year.
cards.say: orbit. The Earth completes one orbit around the Sun every year.

cards.back:
An animal that hunts and eats other animals.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemangsa
Example: The eagle is a predator that hunts small animals.
cards.say: predator. The eagle is a predator that hunts small animals.

cards.back:
An animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal.
Bahasa Indonesia: mangsa
Example: The fox crept closer to its prey, a rabbit in the grass.
cards.say: prey. The fox crept closer to its prey, a rabbit in the grass.

cards.back:
A substance that living things need to grow.
Bahasa Indonesia: zat gizi
Example: Roots take nutrients from the soil to feed the plant.
cards.say: nutrient. Roots take nutrients from the soil to feed the plant.

cards.back:
Able to grow good crops or plants.
Bahasa Indonesia: subur
Example: The land near the volcano is fertile and full of rice fields.
cards.say: fertile. The land near the volcano is fertile and full of rice fields.

cards.back:
The rising and sinking of the sea level each day.
Bahasa Indonesia: pasang surut
Example: At low tide, we could walk far across the wet sand.
cards.say: tide. At low tide, we could walk far across the wet sand.

cards.back:
Water or air moving steadily in one direction.
Bahasa Indonesia: arus
Example: A strong current carried the boat down the river.
cards.say: current. A strong current carried the boat down the river.

cards.back:
The remains of an ancient plant or animal found in rock.
Bahasa Indonesia: fosil
Example: She found a fossil of a shell in the old rock.
cards.say: fossil. She found a fossil of a shell in the old rock.

cards.back:
A natural substance found in the ground, such as salt or gold.
Bahasa Indonesia: mineral
Example: Salt is a mineral that we use to flavour food.
cards.say: mineral. Salt is a mineral that we use to flavour food.

cards.back:
An object that moves around a planet in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: satelit
Example: The Moon is a natural satellite of the Earth.
cards.say: satellite. The Moon is a natural satellite of the Earth.

cards.back:
A piece of land with water all around it.
Bahasa Indonesia: pulau
Example: We took a small boat to the island at the edge of the bay.
cards.say: island. We took a small boat to the island at the edge of the bay.
